title: Match summary
description: Public match metadata from the lobby REST API. Defined by boardgame.io; consumed by both products and owned by neither.

match-id.description: Framework-generated match id. Also the invite URL's path segment: /play/:matchID.

game-name.description: The registered game. This deployment serves exactly one.

id.description: Seat index. Note this is an integer here, while the game state keys seats by the same value as a string.

name.description: Display name, set at join. ABSENT means the seat is free: both clients test occupancy with exactly this.

is-connected.description: Whether a socket is currently attached to this seat. Not read anywhere in this repository.

data.description: Opaque per-seat payload the framework allows. Unused here.

items.description: Public seat metadata. The per-seat credentials are stripped from this view and returned only to the joiner.

players.description: One entry per seat, created at match creation. Length is the room size, not the number of players present.

setup-data.description: Opaque setup payload passed at match creation. Unused here; the game derives everything from seat count at start.

gameover.description: The endIf result once the match is finished: { winner, winners }. Absent while playing. listMatches filters on it.

next-match-id.description: Set by the framework's play-again endpoint. No code in this repository calls it or reads this.

unlisted.description: Hides the match from listMatches. Never set here: every room is listed, which is what lets an agent discover one.

created-at.description: Epoch milliseconds, from Date.now(). Not an RFC 3339 string.

updated-at.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last state change.
